title: Download scoped all-matching order sales currency summaries as PDF
description: A user downloads the filtered all-matching approved order sales currency summary as Chinese PDF from the order-profit designer. Add a summary/pdf endpoint and a narrow Infrastructure exporter using existing PDFsharp/SimHeiPdfFontResolver, consuming the same freshly authorized/validated ERP-224 summary. Preserve stable currency rows/counts/signed known sales, explicit unknown currency/null money and normalized dates/filters/all-matching/source-cap/unknown-cost context; paginate rows and provide explicit empty evidence. Never combine currencies, cost/current-price estimates/profit sums or claim realized/collected revenue. Missing fonts/render failures return a clear error and no corrupt file. Designer sends current filters independently of prior preview, retains form on errors and distinguishes summary from detail-page PDF. Existing Excel/detail PDF stay compatible. Development only: reuse existing order-profit menu, fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService, approved nondeleted scoped SalesOrders and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Do not accept client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority or widen ERP permissions. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible actions, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated work. Run focused in-memory API/service/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Any unavailable external environment acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Summary PDF independently validates current dates/filters and rechecks current identity/menu/scope via the existing server summary; invalid/revoked/cap-overflow requests return no file.

Infrastructure PDF exporter preserves original-currency rows, counts/signed known money, explicit unknown/null evidence and all-matching/filter/date/limit/basis context with pagination, empty evidence and explicit font/render failure.
Designer summary PDF sends current filters and handles download errors without losing state; PDF/UI and Excel/detail-export compatibility tests plus safe Release build/test pass.
